name: Residence Permit for Employment (C Category)

requirements.blocker_text: Official request letter from an inviting Mongolian organization/legal entity, stating its type of activity, duration of stay, and employment need.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Mongolia-registered employer.

requirements.blocker_text: A work permit/authorization from Mongolia's labour and welfare authorities, obtained separately from (and prior to) the residence permit.
Must apply at the Immigration Agency within 21 days of entering Mongolia, appearing in person for biometric registration.

evidence_required.document: Labour and welfare authority work permit

outcome.duration_length: set by the employer's invitation letter and stated employment duration; not independently capped in sources fetched

sources.title: Immigration Agency of Mongolia -- C1 employment residence permit: employer invitation letter mandatory, separate labour/welfare-authority work authorization required, passport valid 180+ days, biometric registration, apply within 21 days of entry, 135,000 MNT standard (5 working days) / 255,000 MNT expedited (3 working days) processing, $7 residency card fee

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mongolia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 IGI-equivalent (Immigration Agency of Mongolia) sourced. A near-identical C3 employment category exists per the same agency (fetched separately) without a clearly disclosed distinction from C1 in the sources reached in this pass -- only C1 is modeled here as the primary employment route; the C1/C3 distinction is flagged as an open question rather than guessed at. work_rights is 'restricted' (tied to the sponsoring employer, consistent with this dataset's convention for employer-sponsored work routes) rather than 'full'. pr_after_months (36) and citizenship_after_months (96) are inferred from the G/immigrant category's 3-year prior-residence threshold (see mn_permanent_residence.json) and the naturalisation law's 5-year-on-permanent-residence requirement (see mn_citizenship_naturalisation.json) stacked together (36 + 60 = 96) -- not figures IGI states directly for C1 holders specifically, and flagged as an inference.
